Mɛɖaxó Reid kpéwú bó kùn mɔ̌to Néo-Zélande tɔn A1GP, Black Beauty é agbɔ̌n-wezùn tɔn hú aliga kɛnnɛ ganxuxo ɖokpó mɛ (160km/h) azɔn tɛ́nwe ɖ'anǎ ɔ ji e.

Kponɔ Néo-Zélande tɔn lɛ mɔ wǔvɛ dó zán mɔ̀ do tuùn agbɔ̌n-wezùn mɛɖaxó Reid tɔn, ɖó Black Beauty ɔ ɖò do tawun bɔ azɔn ɖokpó e Kponɔ lɛ kpéwú bó lɛn ganmɛ nú mɛɖaxó Reid e ɔ́, hwe e nu e é nɔ te ɖ'agbɔ̌n-wezùn kɛnnɛ ganxuxo ɖokpó mɛ (160km/h) é wɛ.
